failedAssertions.reason: Outreach section does not auto-update after scoring rerun. After rescoring contacts, the Outreach section continues showing stale scores and old ranking (e.g., Saurabh Kumar #3 at 83/100 instead of new Jamie Michaels #3 at 86/100). A full page reload is required to see updated outreach recommendations. The scoring rerun's revalidatePath/server action does not propagate updated scores to the Outreach section's client-side state.
